status: synthetic scenario matrix for engineering/economic sensitivity only; no costed route or approval

notes: The 2026-10-15 dtic statement is a primary policy-risk signal; project-specific rules and implementation must be checked against current instruments and written authority guidance.
The SARS APDP2 page describes program context; its presence is not proof that this project or route is eligible.
The matrix does not assume a subsidy, incentive, local-content percentage or compliant CKD/SKD classification.

route_definitions.label: Import complete vehicle
invariants: Use as market/ownership-cost comparator; do not present as local-manufacturing capability.
Bind candidate comparison to exact grade, model year and written landed-cost quotation.
No advertised-from price may stand in for landed cost or ten-year ownership cost.
unlock_evidence: dated written supplier/dealer quote
exact variant and applicable safety/approval evidence
common parts-and-service price basket

route_definitions.label: Import qualified modules; develop local service parts and non-safety-critical assemblies
invariants: Safety-critical imported modules retain exact qualified part/configuration identity.
Every local substitute needs compatibility, quality and applicable approval evidence before use.
Local service parts and workshop tooling are modeled separately from road-vehicle assembly or tax-incentive eligibility.
unlock_evidence: dated module and local-component quotes
quality-system and supplier-capability evidence
part compatibility and engineering qualification for each safety-relevant item
written confirmation of the applicable legal/manufacturing route

route_definitions.label: Local value-add / CKD-style manufacture only if current requirements are confirmed
invariants: Never assume SKD support, CKD status, APDP2 eligibility or incentive amounts from the public announcement alone.
No incentive or rebate enters the base case until the current rule and project-specific eligibility are confirmed.
Tooling, capex, homologation, training, supplier qualification and warranty costs are mandatory model categories.
unlock_evidence: written project-specific route/eligibility confirmation from the competent authority
current governing instruments and applicable rebate items
supplier quotations and capacity/quality evidence
tooling/capex quotations and a documented break-even model

negative_controls.mutation: Set incentive_or_rebate_zar to 0 and claim the local route is fully costed despite unresolved eligibility.
negative_controls.invariant: Unknown or unconfirmed incentives are unresolved, not a verified zero or an assumed benefit.

negative_controls.mutation: Replace an imported safety-critical module with a locally sourced item without compatibility/qualification evidence.
negative_controls.invariant: Local availability does not establish interchangeability or safety.

negative_controls.mutation: Treat the dtic announcement by itself as complete implementation and project-specific legal eligibility.
negative_controls.invariant: Announcement, current legal instrument and individual eligibility are distinct evidence.

negative_controls.mutation: Use one advertised manufacturer starting price as vehicle landed cost or total ownership cost.
negative_controls.invariant: Advertised-from snapshots, written landed quotes and lifecycle cost are distinct quantities.

negative_controls.mutation: Represent 250, 2,500 or 25,000 vehicles/year sensitivity tiers as demand evidence.
negative_controls.invariant: Synthetic volume tiers do not establish demand, market share, order book or production economics.

required_cost_categories: supplier minimum order quantity and lead time
program incentives only after eligibility verified
claim_ceiling: This is a synthetic sensitivity matrix, not a market forecast or a factory-cost estimate.
Null cost fields are intentionally unresolved; they must not be coerced to zero.
The source registry supports discovery and risk framing, not legal advice or an approval.
A route remains blocked when required legal, engineering or supplier evidence is absent.
